name: OmniVoice
summary: k2-fsa's fast diffusion TTS for 600+ languages. Clones a voice, or builds one from attributes like gender, age, pitch and accent.

license.name: CC-BY-NC-4.0
license.summary: Non-commercial use only, with credit to the authors (the weights inherit this from their training data). The code is Apache-2.0.

parameters.label: Quality steps
parameters.help: More steps sound cleaner but take longer. 16 is quick, 32 is the sweet spot, 64 is best.

parameters.label: Guidance
parameters.help: How strictly the voice follows the text and the voice prompt. Too high can sound strained.

parameters.label: Fixed length
parameters.help: Force the clip to this many seconds (speeds up or slows down the delivery). 0 lets the model decide.

parameters.label: Time shift
parameters.help: Shapes the diffusion schedule. Lower settles detail earlier; leave it unless you're experimenting.

parameters.label: Timing randomness
parameters.help: How freely the model picks which parts of the audio to fill in first. Higher varies rhythm more.

parameters.label: Sound randomness
parameters.help: Randomness when choosing each sound. 0 always takes the most likely one.

parameters.label: Layer penalty
parameters.help: Makes the model settle coarse sound layers before fine ones. Leave at 5 unless experimenting.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.help: Fix this to get the same take again from the same settings. Leave empty for a fresh take each time.

descriptionHelp: OmniVoice takes attributes, not a description: one from any of gender (male, female), age (child, teenager, young adult, middle-aged, elderly), pitch (very low, low, moderate, high or very high pitch), whisper, and an English accent (american, british, australian, canadian, indian, chinese, korean, japanese, portuguese or russian accent), separated by commas. For example: female, young adult, low pitch, british accent.
